note: Castle Provincial Park campground 20 km west of Pincher Creek on Hwy 507, 16 km south on Hwy 774 and 15 km west on O'Hagen Road: spacious treed sites in a South Loop (10-27) west of the road and a River Loop (1-9) on the Carbondale River side, with a day-use area. OHV trails are in the area; OHVs must stay on their trailers within the campground. No firewood is available; bring or buy it locally. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page and the Castle tear sheet (Feb 2025): 27 unserviced first-come sites C$23, season May 12 - Sep 30 (manual, matches), pit toilets (accessible), non-potable pump. Riverview kept on the page's 'a few by the creek' and the River Loop layout; OHV wording flagged (general campground). Phone 403-627-1165 suggested.
flags: OHV (reviewer's call; reads as a general campground with an OHV side, so a keep): 'There are OHV trails in the area, though OHVs must be kept on trailers within the campground.' No staging, trailhead or OHV-zone wording for this campground; the park's OHV staging areas (Carbondale Staging, Syncline-Barnaby Staging) are separate day-use sites on the tear sheet.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview, checked hard): KEEP RIVERVIEW, no upgrade. Page: 'spacious sites surrounded by trees, with a few by the creek.' The tear sheet draws the River Loop (sites 1-9) between the road and the Carbondale River, with 4-8 nearest it. Esri imagery (2024-06-13): River Loop spur ends sit in partly open grass with scattered spruce ~30-45 m from the channel, which runs in a shaded cut; no site reaches open ground at the bank, so riverfront/creekside is not earned. If the reviewer reads the trees as blocking the view, the lower value is not waterfront.
PHONE (stored empty): page 'Information: 403-627-1165' (Castle Provincial Park on the tear sheet). Recommend 403-627-1165.
ADVISORY on the page is for Designated Camping Area 3B (Wolfberry) partial closure May 1 - Nov 30, 2026: not Lynx Creek.
STATUS: Current Status 'Seasonal Closure'. FCFS: not on shop.albertaparks.ca (Castle's shop parkId 330291 lists the reservable campgrounds only).
